description.en: Whenever you cast the last charge of an [arcane] spell, your next non arcane spell is free for 1 turn.
Whenever a unit is killed by arcane damage, that unit explodes for [12_arcane:arcane] damage in a square with a [1_tile:radius] radius, melting walls on effected tiles.
Whenever you cast an [arcane] spell, if you have no shields, gain [1_SH:shields].

Every 5 turns, if you have less than [2:num_summons] Bone Knights, summon a Bone Knight.
Bone knights are shielded melee units with a [dark] melee attack that drains max life.

Every 5 turns, summon a chaos chimera familiar if you do not currently have one.
The familiar has ranged [fire] and [lightning] attacks, and splits into a lightning snake and a fire lion on death.
The familiar can cast your Fireball, Lightning Bolt, Thunder Strike, Pyrostatic Pulse, Immolate, and Chaos Barrage spells on a 3 turn cooldown.
Your [sorcery] spells gain [2_damage:damage] for each [frozen] or [glassified] unit.

Every 5 turns, summon a deathchill chimera familiar if you do not currently have one.
The familiar has ranged [ice] and [dark] attacks, and splits into a death snake and an ice lion on death.
The familiar can cast your Deathbolt, Icicle, Freeze, Iceball, Life Drain, Touch of Death, and Plague of Undeath spells on a 3 turn cooldown.

each level with a friendly Fae Stone.  The Fae Stone is a sturdy immobile melee unit.

Whenever you cast an arcane spell, the Fae Stone teleports near the target and gains 1 shield.

Whenever you cast a nature spell, the Fae Stone heals 10 HP.
Each turn all frozen enemies take [6_dark:dark] damage.
Whenever an enemy is [frozen], reduces that enemy's [physical] and [ice] resist by 100 until it is unfrozen.

When you cast three [arcane] spells in a row, regain a charge of a random [translocation] spell and summon [2_faeries:num_summons].
The faeries fly, blink, are shielded, can heal their allies, and have an [arcane] ranged attack.
The faeries vanish after [10_turns:minion_duration].

Your living minions gain [75_ice:ice] resist.
Your living minions freeze for [3_turns:duration] upon taking ice damage.
Your living minions heal for [15_HP:heal] each turn while [frozen].

Whenever a [frozen] enemy takes [holy] damage, you and all allies in line of sight gain [1_SH:shields], up to a max of [5:shields].
Whenever a [frozen] enemy is slain by [holy] damage, deal [17_holy:holy] damage to 3 random enemies in line of sight of the slain unit.

Whenever you cast a [fire] spell, if you have less than [4:num_summons] hellhounds, summon a hellhound.
Hell hounds have a leap attack, fiery bodies which deal damage to melee attackers, and [fire] melee attacks.

Your summoned [undead] units gain Hunger.
Hunger deals [7_dark:dark] damage to a target up to [3_tiles:range] away, healing the caster for all damage dealt, and has a [3_turn:cooldown] cooldown.

Whenever you cast a [nature] or [lightning] spell, gain lifespark with duration equal to the spell's level.
Every turn you have active lifespark, summon a lightning bug swarm, which disappears after 25 turns.

Whenever you cast a [lightning] spell, all non stationary enemy units within [3_tiles:radius] of the target are teleported to random spaces up to [5_tiles:range] away and take [9_lightning:lightning] damage.  Enemies will always be teleported at least 4 tiles away from the wizard.
Poisoned enemies take [4:poison] additional [poison] damage each turn.
Whenever an enemy takes [fire] damage, it loses [10_physical:physical] resist.
Each turn, heal each of your minions for [2_HP:heal]
Whenever you cast a [nature] spell, you and all [living] allies heal [5_HP:heal].
Your summoned units gain [25_physical:physical] resist, [25_lightning:lightning] resist, [25_ice:ice] resist and [25_fire:fire] resist.
Whenever an enemy takes [poison] damage, it has a 25% chance to be [stunned] for [1_turn:duration].
Whenever an enemy dies to [fire], [physical], or [lightning] damage, deal [13_damage:damage] of that type to a random enemy in line of sight of the target up to [5_tiles:radius] away.
Whenever you cast an [ice] spell, [freeze] the nearest unfrozen enemy to that spell's target for [3_turns:duration].
Arcane minions you summon gain [3_SH:shields].  Other minions you summon gain [1_SH:shields].

You are a [spider].
Passively spawn a web each turn on a random adjacent tile.  Webs will not spawn on top of units or walls.
Whenever you cast a translocation spell targeting a web, refund 1 charge of that spell and consume the web.
Whenever an enemy dies to [poison] damage, summon a friendly spider nearby.
Whenever you cast a translocation spell, summon a stormtroll trickster at the location you cast the spell from.

Whenever a living ally takes damage, gain that much toadblood.
At 250 toadblood, summon a towering toadbeast near the most recently damaged ally.
Current toadblood: 0

Whenever you summon an [undead] or [demon], if you control a [holy] unit, the newly summoned unit gains [7_damage:damage].
Whenever you summon a [holy] creature, if you control an [undead] or [demon], the newly summoned unit gains [7_damage:damage].

Your summoned [living] and [nature] units gain Venom Spit.
Venom spit is a ranged attack which deals [4_poison:poison] damage and inflicts [poison] for [10_turns:duration].
Venom spit has a [6_tile:range] range, and a [4_turn:cooldown] cooldown.

Whenever you cast a [fire] or [arcane] spell, gain starcharged with duration equal to the spell's level.
Starcharged deals [6_arcane:arcane] damage to one random enemy in line of sight each turn, and then [6_fire:fire] damage to another.

Each turn, a random unacidified enemy is acidified.
Acidified units lose 100 [poison] resist.
Each turn, a random summoned ally equips a copy of your armor.
For every 6 HP spent casting spells, summon a bloodghast for 13 turns.
Whenever an enemy [demon] or [living] unit dies, gain 2 HP
Whenever you cast a [chaos] spell, you have a 25% chance of regaining a charge of another random [chaos] spell
Each turn, deal 2x the sum total of all [poison] damage dealt to all units to the nearest enemy as [dark] damage.
Redeal half of all damage dealt to enemy units by [demon] allies as [poison] damage

Whenever you cast a [nature] or [chaos] spell, send out tremors along the ground from the target to nearby enemies.
Each tremor deals [9_physical:physical] damage to the target and all units in its path.
The base number of targets is equal to the level of the spell.
The tremors can target enemies up to [8:radius] tiles away.

Redeal 50% of all [physical], [poison], [lightning], and [ice] damage dealt to enemies by [enchantments:enchantment] as [arcane] damage.
Redeal 50% of all other damage dealt to enemies by [enchantments:enchantment] as [poison] damage.
Whenever an enemy takes [fire] damage, redeal that damage as [holy] damage.
Gain [4_turns:duration] of Clarity when you cast a channeled spell.

Whenever an enemy takes [dark] damage and [fire] damage in the same turn, summon a burning ghost near that enemy.
The ghosts vanish after [10_turns:minion_duration].

Slimes you summon receive the [Metallic] boss modifier and the Ecophagy buff.
Ecophagy causes slimes to eat any adjacent walls at the end of their turn.
The slime gains 1 maximum and current health for each wall consumed this way.
Whenever an allied unit heals, deal that much [poison] damage to up to [2:num_targets] enemy units in a [5_tile:radius] burst.
Each turn, deal [1:damage] [arcane] damage to enemy units for each debuff they have.
Whenever an enemy takes [lightning] damage, redeal that damage as [holy] damage.
Whenever an enemy dies to [dark] damage, up to [3:num_targets] random enemies in line of sight of that enemy are afflicted by fear for [5_turns:duration]

Whenever you cast a [dark] spell, if your next spell is a [holy] spell of a lower level, that spell's cost is refunded.
Whenever you cast a [holy] spell, if your next spell is a [dark] spell of a lower level, that spell's cost is refunded.
When one of your [Eye] spells damages an enemy, inflict [2:duration] turns of fear on them.
You get +1 [lightning] damage for each undead ally you control.
Whenever you or an allied unit deals physical damage to an enemy, if the source of that damage is shielded, redeal 50% of that damage as arcane and 50% of that damage as holy.
Whenever a summoned minion witnesses an enemy take [fire] damage, that minion heals for half that damage.
Whenever an enemy dies to [holy] damage, yourself and other allies witnessing it gain [1_SH:shields] if they are not already shielded.

At the end of your turn, if you control 10 or more [living] or [arcane] allies and no Egregore, summon a Scalefeather Egregore.
The Egregore can cast your blizzard, nightmare aura, devour mind, void beam, toxin burst, and lumbriogenesis spells if you have them.
The Egregore is unsummoned at the end of your turn if you control fewer than 10 [living] or [arcane] allies.

Whenever you cast a [fire] spell, deal [1_fire:fire] damage to all enemies in line of sight of the target.
This damage is fixed and cannot be modified.
Whenever an allied slime is summoned, their chance to grow is set to 75% rather than the base 50%.
When an allied [slime:slime] is spawned, it casts a random cantrip you know that shares a tag with it.

Whenever an ally loses a shield, deal [3_physical:physical] and [3_arcane:arcane] damage and apply silence for [2_turns:duration] to up to [2_enemies:num_targets] up to [5_tiles:radius] away and in line of sight.
Whenever an enemy takes [fire] damage, deal that much [arcane] damage to up to [4:num_targets] adjacent enemies.

Whenever you cast an [arcane] or [nature] spell, summon [3:num_summons] fae thorns near the target.
Fae Thorns have [10_HP:minion_health], and cannot move.
Fae Thorns have a melee attack which deals [4_physical:physical] damage.
The thorns vanish after [9_turns:minion_duration].
All of your [Blood] and [Fire] spells gain quickcast (the first one cast each turn does not conclude the turn).
Whenever an enemy takes [holy] damage, it has a 50% chance to be [stunned] for [1_turns:duration].
Whenever an enemy takes [arcane] damage, deal that much [lightning] damage to up to [2:num_targets] enemy units in a [6_tile:radius] burst.
Whenever you cast the same [sorcery] spell twice in a row, gain a charge of that spell.

Whenever you cast an [arcane] spell targeting a [frozen] unit, make a copy of that spell targeting each other frozen unit in line of sight.
Remove [frozen] from all affected units.
Whenever one of your minions dies, up to [3:num_targets] random enemies in a [5_tile:radius] radius take [ice] damage equal to half the dead minion's max HP.

Whenever you cast a [fire] spell, all of your [metallic] allies gain [2_damage:damage] [fire] aura with radius equal to the level of the spell you cast for [10_turns:duration].
This damage is fixed and cannot be modified.
Whenever you cast a [lightning] spell, your [lightning] spells and skills gain [4_damage:damage] for [6_turns:duration]
Whenever an enemy takes [arcane] damage, all [holy] minions in line of sight of that enemy redeal 50% of that damage as [holy] damage.
Whenever you cast a [metallic] spell, deal 27 [physical] damage to 1 enemy in line of sight per spell level.
Whenever an allied [dragon] uses a breath weapon, all your summoned units gain 100 resist to that breath weapon's element for [5_turns:duration]
Whenever a unit is unfrozen or a [frozen] unit is killed, up to [3_enemies:num_targets] in a [6_tile:radius] burst take [6_ice:ice] and [6_physical:physical] damage.

Whenever a unit is unfrozen by fire damage, spawn 3 friendly steam elementals nearby for 6 turns.

The steam elemental has a ranged fire attack, and is immune to fire, ice and physical damage.

Whenever [ice] or [lightning] damage is dealt to an enemy unit, create a blizzard or thundercloud nearby.
The blizzards deal [5_ice:ice] damage and may freeze enemies, the thunderclouds strike inconsistently but deal twice as much [lightning] damage.
The clouds last [5_turns:duration].
Each turn, if at least 13 fire, lightning and physical damage were dealt to enemies, summon a Chaos Quill.

For every 40 damage dealt by [sorcery] spells you cast, deal [1_physical:physical] damage to all enemy units.
This damage cannot be boosted.
Whenever you cast a self targeted enchantment spell, a random minion also casts it.
Whenever 125 damage is dealt by [blood] or [nature] spells, skills, or summons, summon a blood hound
Whenever you deal 6 or more fire, lightning, or physical damage, summon a corresponding snake for 4 turns.  The snakes attacks deal half the dealt damage.

Whenever an enemy dies to [lightning] damage, another random enemy in line of sight of that enemy goes [berserk] for [5_turns:duration].
[Berserk] units are hostile to all other units, they will attack and be attacked by their allies.

Whenever an enemy unit dies, each of your [dark] spells has a 10% chance of gaining a charge.
This chance is tripled if the unit died to [dark] damage.
Whenever you or one of your [arcane] or [undead] allies take damage from an enemy, deal [5_arcane:arcane] damage to the source of that damage.
